cases.description: Three-stage party data with stage-specific staff, notes and a legacy random custom-task key.
migrationRequirements: Keep staff and notes separate by stage.
Do not associate a random custom-task key with a label without evidence.
The old Firestore checkbox backup disagrees with RTDB; do not silently choose a winner.

cases.description: Event-wide header values and a string guest count written by manual Save.
migrationRequirements: Preserve shared times and safely normalize numeric strings.

cases.description: Separate hall-access field and shared task map; absent quantity data was never saved.
migrationRequirements: Retain feastSetupHallAccessTime when introducing a common access-time field.
Missing values are unknown; do not invent previous quantities.

cases.description: Saved notes and string-valued item quantities, including zero and multiple fields per row.
migrationRequirements: Preserve zero quantities and all field suffixes.
Task prefixes may have been cached before metadata arrived; reconcile aliases before rewriting keys.

cases.description: Unprefixed shared task keys plus the manually saved Firestore checkbox backup.
migrationRequirements: Map unprefixed and event-type-prefixed task identities without losing completion.

cases.description: Positional RTDB checkbox IDs and manually saved notes/bar times.
migrationRequirements: Resolve cb_i and ta_i against the original page/task order, including inserted custom tasks.
Do not mistake a blank saved note for missing data.

cases.description: Wake setup stores task objects; during/clear-up store booleans inside a nested tasks map.
migrationRequirements: Boolean tasks contain no completion actor/time: do not fabricate them.
Nested data needs a compatibility adapter; it is not a shared flat task map.

cases.description: Synthetic state after the flat shared writer replaced the Wake stage object.
migrationRequirements: Missing staffNames/guests cannot be recovered from this snapshot. Preserve remaining completion data.

cases.description: Identical task IDs in different event IDs must remain independent.
migrationRequirements: Keep event identity in every lookup and write.

cases.description: Duplicate labels and conflicting time aliases require explicit reconciliation.
migrationRequirements: Two identical labels do not identify which random completion key belongs to which task.
Preserve both time values until a conflict policy is defined.

cases.description: Fresh event, old event with no type, archived event, and RTDB data whose Firestore document is absent.
migrationRequirements: Absence of a stage means no saved stage data.
A missing Firestore document must not be recreated automatically by checklist writes.
Archived events must retain their saved information.
